operator_level_dedup: Möbelkiste Hamburg is a project/business operation of einfal gGmbH and counts once at legal-operator level. Other einfal social-shop projects must deduplicate to the same company if encountered.
reason: Independent PASS2 confirms a current Hamburg social second-hand retail operator that includes clothing. The first-party site describes a 1,700 m² social department store with new and well-preserved used furniture, clothing and household goods, daily changing stock and current 2026 retail activity including a fashion show. Its first-party imprint identifies einfal gGmbH, Hamburg HRB 69039 and VAT DE196919890. Normal shopping eligibility is restricted to low-income customers who must provide proof and receive a customer card. No current item-level remote apparel purchasing path or ordinary delivery to Spain is established. The operator is therefore VERIFIED_HOLD, not ELIGIBLE.

evidence.finding: Current site describes Hamburg's large social department store with new and well-preserved furniture, clothing, household goods and changing offers; includes a 29 March 2026 Sunday opening and fashion show.
Current eligibility page restricts normal shopping to low-income customers and requires proof plus a customer card.
Imprint identifies Möbelkiste Hamburg as a project of einfal gGmbH, management Karen Risse and Grietje Bergmeyer, Amtsgericht Hamburg HRB 69039 and VAT DE196919890.
Owned site maintains a clothing category and directs customers to the physical store for the broader changing apparel assortment.
